_comment: 1.2 m extended-object variant of scenario_extended_tracking.json (target realism report, Part II §10), for the single-run tracking timeline. IDENTICAL target (4 m, 0.5 m/s, amplitude 0.0009) except the `extent` field is set inline (K=10 scatterers over 1.2 m) instead of injected per sweep cell, so `tracker_stress.py` can plot one run. Pair the unfixed baseline (`--cluster-method cc`, default R -> the blob fragments) against `--cluster-method dbscan --range-meas-var 4.89` (matched R for 1.2 m, from §10.1) to visualise the two fixes. Single-seed illustration; the statistic is §10.3's matrix.
